name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3371: CI swallow ratchet caught this ON THE DAY v3364 SHIPPED THE FILE and it was then ignored for five consecutive versions because nobody read CI. Routine M was success on v3363 (3b1d513d) and FAILURE on v3364 (5aaffe75), the version that added affix_lexicon.py, then failure on v3365 through v3368. The ratchet named it exactly - RANK 1, a failed read handed back as DATA, baseline 70 now 71, WHERE IT ROSE tv/affix_lexicon.py 0 to 1. THE SITE: _strings did except Exception return an empty dict. WHY THAT IS A LIE HERE: build already distinguishes an ABSENT source and says so precisely, but a source that ARRIVES AND WILL NOT PARSE became an empty dict and sailed through - resolve finds no hits, the lexicon reports 0 affixes, and classify answers UNKNOWN for every name in the game. DEMONSTRATED END TO END rather than inferred: stubbing _pull to return garbage for every source returned a COMPLETE-LOOKING lexicon with no reason string, while stubbing it to None correctly refused. HEART: the watcher already exists and is the item vocabulary row, and this fix CORRECTS WHAT IT SAYS rather than needing a new one. Before, a corrupt source still produced a lexicon whose sourceHash differed from the stored one, so verify returned 1 STALE and the row told him the install has changed since the lexicon was generated - a confidently WRONG CAUSE that would send him to regenerate against an install that never moved. Now build refuses, verify returns SKIP, and the row reads UNKNOWN carrying the real reason; a new case pins that end to end and SKIP is not green by verify own docstring. ABSENT AND CORRUPT MUST NOT COLLAPSE EITHER: an absent blob is already counted in absent and naming it unparseable would report the wrong cause. ONE OF THE THREE RED-PROOFS WAS BLIND ON ITS FIRST RUN with a correct match count, so the LAW was weak: the absent case stubbed EVERY source to None, which returns early on the all-absent branch so the line separating absent from corrupt was never reached; a mixed fixture now drives execution through it and all three are PROVEN. 9 cases, 3 red-proofs, 489 gates. THE PROCESS FAILURE IS THE BIGGER HALF: read CI after the push and attribute by delta - I did neither for five ships while the gate shouted into an empty room.
